{{Top|leg}}
The term '''Clawcraft''' was used for many classes of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] used throughout the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] history.

==Description==
The clawcraft differed from the later innovative [[Nssis-class Clawcraft|''Nssis''-class Clawcraft]] by lacking its distinctive [[TIE starfighter|TIE]]-series cockpit, which was a result of technology-sharing between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].<ref name="SOTG">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref>

==History==
Over the course of the Ascendancy's history, dozens of models of clawcraft were fielded.<ref name="SOTG" /> They were often transported through interstellar space in [[Carrier/Legends|Chiss carriers]] and other warships.<ref name="SOTG" /><ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
